description: Nonprofit compliance requirements for one US state, from 501c3.help's sourced records: formation, governance, charitable solicitation registration, reporting, tax and employment. Every record carries its official citation and a verification status. Records marked review_required are unsettled and must be presented as such, never as a settled rule. Optionally narrow by topic. Returns a limited number of records, not the whole state.

state.description: State name or two-letter abbreviation, for example 'Kansas' or 'KS'.

topic.description: Optional topic filter, matched loosely, for example 'solicitation', 'reporting', 'tax'.

name: get_state_requirements
